derivation: a quantitative form (the feminine) of the base of G4225 (πηλίκος);
strongs_def: how much (as an indefinite), i.e. in size or (figuratively) dignity
it_def:
1) quanto grande
   1a) in senso materiale (significa dimensione geometrica, distinta da matematica)
   1b) in senso etico: quanto distinto
